projects.title: Book Zone
projects.description: Book Zone is an Android app that was created for students to buy, sell, and trade textbooks. The app features a home page that displays a feed of books for sale/trade as well as the option to list books, a messaging center, and a customizable profile page. I developed the messaging features that allows users to message the sellers of books as well as search users to message. I also developed the customizable profile page that displays users’ profile picture, name, school, and email for contact. This project was also worked on by two other CPP students.
